result.prior_version_note: Before Measure BB (passed November 2024), the Rent Board set the AGA using the Rent Ordinance's formula of 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase, approved by voters in November 2004. The documents describe the 5% maximum as 'NEW', which implies there was no cap before. The documents do not say when the AGA requirement itself first applied.

effective_date_formula.verbatim: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
